```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

plt.figure(figsize=(14, 6))

ax1 = plt.subplot(121)
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', data=df, palette='viridis')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.title('Transaction Type Distribution by Fraud Status')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Is Fraud', labels=['Non-Fraud', 'Fraud'])

ax2 = plt.subplot(122)
sns.countplot(x='hour_of_day', hue='is_fraud', data=df, palette='viridis')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
